name: A share loss doesn't offset a crypto gain (crypto's closed basket); it's carried forward against redditi diversi
workings: Shares: loss 11,000.00 − 8,000.00 = 3,000.00, a reddito diverso (art. 67 c. 1 lett. c): since 2023 crypto gains and losses are a basket of their own (art. 68 c. 9-bis; circolare 30/E/2023), so the share loss can't offset the crypto gain, and a crypto loss couldn't offset a share gain
Carried forward: 3,000.00 of redditi diversi losses from 2026, usable to 2030 (art. 68 c. 5)
Selling gold in the same year with a 4,000.00 gain, also a reddito diverso (art. 67 c. 1 lett. c-ter): the share loss offsets it, 26% × (4,000.00 − 3,000.00) = 260.00
